author: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, General Headquarters
title: Reports of General MacArthur, Volume II, Part I: Japanese Operations in the Southwest Pacific Area
publisher: General Headquarters, Tokyo; facsimile reprint, U.S. Army Center of Military History, Washington, D.C., 1994
notes: The Japanese conduct of the war in MacArthur's theatre, 'compiled from Japanese Demobilization Bureaux records' as the title page says, printed by MacArthur's Tokyo headquarters in 1950 and reissued unaltered by the Center of Military History in 1994 (CMH Pub 13-1, LC 66-60007). Its own foreword is the caveat, and it is a remarkable one for an official publication: MacArthur while he lived refused to allow the Reports to be reproduced because he believed they needed 'further editing and correction of some inaccuracies', and the Department of the Army, publishing them after his death, states that it 'must therefore disclaim any responsibility for their accuracy'. Cite it, quote that disclaimer in the note, and put a modern study beside it. The scan above is open and was read for this entry; the Center of Military History's own copy is behind a host that refuses this repository's requests.
